description: This script provides functions to generate encrypted passwords for 'admin' and 'root' users, and updates the '/etc/shadow' file with these passwords. It is used for password management, including creating new passwords and replacing existing ones.

methods.name: update_shadow
methods.description: Updates the encrypted password for a specified user in /etc/shadow by performing a string substitution.

methods.name: gen_admin_passwd
methods.description: Generates an encrypted password for the admin user, updates /etc/shadow accordingly, and outputs the encrypted password.

methods.name: gen_root_passwd
methods.description: Generates an encrypted password for the root user, updates /etc/shadow accordingly, and outputs the encrypted password.
